structured.answer: Clal (כלל) has the cheapest S&P 500 keren hishtalmut track at 0.48% a year. Menora Mivtachim is close at 0.49%, and Harel and Migdal are at 0.5%.

stuck.where: Top of the table, first row Mor 0.7%
stuck.why: At first I thought the first row was the cheapest. Then I read the note 'מהיקר לזול' and saw the list goes from most expensive to cheapest, so I had to scroll to the bottom.
There's no fee, just 'עוד לא דווח' with a warning mark. I wasn't sure whether to count it, so I skipped it.

used: The pre-selected קרן השתלמות and עוקב מדד S&P 500 buttons
The line '12 מסלולים של 12 חברות · דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.48% עד 0.7%'
The note 'מסודרים לפי דמי הניהול מהחיסכון, מהיקר לזול'
The 'דמי ניהול' column in each row, and the company names
skimmed: The company names and the number of tracks under them
skipped: The circle charts and the 'חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח' column
The grey notes at the bottom of the table and the PF-06 box
The paragraph about returns at the bottom of the page
The menu tabs and the 'מה זה קרן השתלמות' link
unsure_meaning: תשואה שנתית ממוצעת לפני דמי ניהול
not_found: The fee in shekels for my own amount
A join button or how to move my keren to this company
An explanation of what 'אין ההפקדות' means

findings.what: The table runs from most expensive to cheapest, so the cheapest is at the bottom and the first row looks like the 'winner'.
findings.where: Under the filters: 'מהיקר לזול', first row Mor

findings.what: The fees are only in percent and the differences are tiny (0.48% vs 0.5%), so you can't tell how much money that actually is.
The 'אין ההפקדות' text under every fee isn't explained.
findings.where: Every row in the fee column

findings.what: One company shows a warning and 'עוד לא דווח' instead of a fee, and has only 40% in shares even though it's supposedly an S&P track.
There's no next step: nothing tells you how to join or move your keren.
The returns are 'לפני דמי ניהול'. It's confusing whether that's what I'll actually get.
